panels.description: B11 projects Adrian's route across the workshop wall while Alex stands beside it. Keep the route and both figures readable; leave upper projection space.
Alex looks toward the apartment doorway and Grandmother's medicine, caught between escape and investigation. Leave upper space for his answer.
B11 folds the map with his brass eye ring rotated toward Alex. Leave upper space for his warning.
Alex opens the Measure case and tests one arm against a leaking workshop pipe. Keep the harmless test clear and leave upper space.

items.speaker: B11
items.text: Do you want answers or an exit?

items.speaker: ALEX
items.text: Then I’ll know what I’m paying for.
